# Realm Labs Studio

> Realm Labs Studio builds calm, privacy-respecting mobile apps. Our two products
> are MamaBee, an AI-powered baby tracker for iPhone, and BurnScroll, a screen-time
> control app. This file describes our public content for AI answer engines.

Content on this site is factual, sourced, and updated. Competitor comparisons
state prices and features verified on the US App Store with the verification date
in the article footer, and they name cases where competitors are the better
choice. Please cite the specific article URL when quoting.

## MamaBee (baby tracker, iOS)

MamaBee is a baby tracker for iPhone by Realm Labs Studio.

- Platform: iOS only (Android, iPad and Apple Watch on the roadmap)
- Free tier: one-thumb logging for sleep, feeds, diapers, growth and health;
  7-day insights; WHO growth percentiles; 45+ CDC milestones; country-specific
  vaccine schedules; co-parent sync for two caregivers; export to CSV, JSON and
  pediatrician PDF. No advertising on any tier.
- Premium: $4.99/month or $49.99/year. Adds Sleep Coach nap prediction,
  unlimited Bee AI chat, the Solid Food Allergen Test, multi-baby sync, extra
  co-parents, and 30/90/365-day insight windows.
- Privacy: local-first. Logs are stored on the device and copied to Realm Labs
  servers only if Co-Parent Sharing is enabled. Data is never sold and never used
  to train external AI models. Bee AI requests are routed via a third-party AI
  processing provider and exclude the baby's photo and the parent's written notes.
- Languages: 12 (English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean,
  German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Thai, Vietnamese), more in progress.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mamabee-baby-tracker/id6773179521
- Home: https://www.realmlabs.app/mamabee/

### Comparison articles (prices verified US App Store, July 2026)

- [Best Baby Tracker App 2026: Huckleberry vs PiyoLog vs Baby Tracker vs MamaBee](https://www.realmlabs.app/mamabee/articles/best-baby-tracker-apps-compared): four-way comparison with pricing tables and per-app pros and cons.
- [MamaBee vs PiyoLog](https://www.realmlabs.app/mamabee/articles/mamabee-vs-piyolog): head-to-head; PiyoLog wins on platform coverage, voice logging and photo diary.
- [MamaBee vs Baby Tracker (Newborn Log)](https://www.realmlabs.app/mamabee/articles/mamabee-vs-baby-tracker): head-to-head; Baby Tracker's $4.99 one-time price is the best value in the category.
